stumbles.quote: You should lock screen rotation in portrait before starting, because the game asks for landscape itself with a prompt to turn the phone.
stumbles.why: If rotation is locked in portrait, turning the phone to landscape won't rotate the screen. It's unclear how the prompt can be satisfied or detected. This seems to contradict the instruction to turn the phone to landscape.

stumbles.quote: the game zeroes steering calibration to the phone's current tilt when the start lights go out
stumbles.why: It doesn't say how I should hold the phone at that moment. It also doesn't say whether I can recalibrate. 'Start lights' are mentioned nowhere else, so it's unclear when they happen.

stumbles.quote: Tilting the top of the phone away from you accelerates.
stumbles.why: In landscape, 'top of the phone' is ambiguous. It could mean the top edge in portrait or the edge that is now on top. Pitch versus roll is unclear.

point: Open the game on a motion-sensor phone, choose track, laps and difficulty in portrait, turn to landscape when prompted, then steer by tilting left and right, accelerate by tilting the top away, and brake by tilting it toward you.
